Even before the iPod existed, the Sony Walkman was already a must-have device for anyone who wanted to integrate music into their daily lives. Now there is an app called Duo-Man that can recreate that experience for those of us who once owned a Walkman, and it even works with Apple Music……

Before the Walkman came along, if you wanted to listen to music on the go, there weren't many products to choose from. Most cassette players at the time were heavy and bulky. Sony took a recorder originally designed for journalists and shrunk it down into the smallest cassette player they could make, and the result quickly became an iconic product of its era.

Developer Vidit Bhargava created this app during a hackathon — since many people at the event had never seen a Walkman before, he even brought an actual unit along to show them what it looked like.

You open Duo, pick the album "cassette" you want to insert, then close it and playback begins.

Bhargava said he originally made the demo app just for fun, but will now officially release it to the market. The best comment on the X post is this one — the image is something only people of a certain age will understand.

What was your first music player? Feel free to share in the comments section.
